EFW_OlyriaTrench.name: Olyria-Prime Trench
EFW_OlyriaTrench.text: A working excavation cut into black bedrock beneath Olyria-Prime. Heavy drills, work lamps, dust, ladders and exhausted crews should feel ordinary enough that the impossible thing beneath them is genuinely disruptive.

EFW_ZenithArchives.name: Zenith Spire Archives
EFW_ZenithArchives.text: A vast institutional archive above the planet: ordered shelves, old ledgers, modern records, quiet administrative power. Beauty comes from scale and altitude, not constant spectacle.

EFW_SectorFour.name: Sector Four Excavation
EFW_SectorFour.text: The newly opened section of the trench where the buried structure has emerged. Treat the object as a historical wound made physical, not as a machine awaiting diagnosis.

EFW_GridRuins.name: Stabilizing Grid Ruins
EFW_GridRuins.text: A damaged excavation tier after the first awakening. Dust, broken platforms and stunned workers. Adrian's arrival should make the human silence more important than the wreckage.

EFW_TelemetryRoom.name: Zenith Telemetry Room
EFW_TelemetryRoom.text: A secure records room. The drama is ownership of evidence and institutional pressure, not displays full of invented technical readings.

EFW_TriageTent.name: Olyria Triage Tent
EFW_TriageTent.text: A temporary field medical tent full of ordinary post-accident clutter, tired workers and bad coffee. Use it to give the episode human scale.

EFW_LowerArchives.name: Lower-Tier Archives
EFW_LowerArchives.text: Older, less-used stacks beneath the polished public archive. Physical books and sealed records suggest deliberate historical burial.

EFW_ObservationDeck.name: Zenith Observation Deck
EFW_ObservationDeck.text: A quiet high-altitude deck overlooking a bruised sky and the Spire below. A disposal furnace is present as ordinary infrastructure, not a spectacle device.

EFW_AbandonedTrench.name: Abandoned Trench
EFW_AbandonedTrench.text: A shut-down excavation cut where Theo tries to hide what he found. Sparse work lights, scrap and deep shadow.

EFW_CompactedEarth.name: Compacted Earth Above Sector Four
EFW_CompactedEarth.text: The surface above the buried relic beneath silent excavators and open stars. The final scene should feel exposed and still.
